mapper.select: SELECT id, request_uid, campaign_id, user_id, status, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, accepted_at, NOW(6)) AS accepted_age_micros FROM purchase_request WHERE id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE purchase_request SET status = 'SYSTEM_FAILED', reject_reason = 'REQUEST_FAILED', finished_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{requestId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_message (event_id, topic, msg_key, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, 'flashorder.order-commands.DLT', #{messageKey}, 'ORDER_COMMAND_FAILED', JSON_OBJECT('eventId', #{eventId}, 'eventType', 'ORDER_COMMAND_FAILED', 'requestId', #{requestId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'requestUid', #{requestUid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'campaignId', #{campaignId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 'sourceTopic', #{sourceTopic}, 'sourcePartition', #{sourcePartition}, 'sourceOffset', #{sourceOffset}, 'errorType', #{errorType}, 'originalPayload', #{originalPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'payloadTruncated', #{payloadTruncated}), NOW(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = outbox_message.event_id
